data.title: Penciclovir 1% cream
data.summary: Antivirals & ART · Topical guanosine analogue (active metabolite of famciclovir)
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Antivirals & ART_

**Class:** Topical guanosine analogue (active metabolite of famciclovir)

## Mechanism of action
- Phosphorylated by viral thymidine kinase → inhibits viral DNA polymerase; long intracellular half-life

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Recurrent herpes labialis in adults and children over 12 (slightly better than topical acyclovir)

## Dose & formulations
- Every 2 h while awake for 4 days, starting at the first sign

## Adverse effects
- Local irritation, numbness

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity; mucous membranes

## Pregnancy & lactation
Minimal absorption — acceptable.

## Viva points
- Topical form of famciclovir's active drug; frequent application needed

_Sources: Khopkar ch.20 (Penciclovir); Wolverton 4e ch.43. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
